messages.author: c102ef7f5617067f
messages.subject: Using sox() function
parts:
I'm trying to use sox function. I'm on osx

First I installed Home Brew by running this command in Terminal: ruby -e "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.github.com/Homebrew/homebrew/go/install)"

Then installed sox by running this command in the terminal: brew install sox

This all seemed to go to plan, and it appeared sox had installed. 

But if try to run either of these commands in R, nothing happens:

sox(" -V tico.wav /Users/rossahmed/Desktop/out.wav bandreject 4000, 2000")

Could somebody tell me what I'm doing wrong please?

Thanks
Ross

messages.author: d91178de15999ecf
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Using sox() function
parts:
If sox works on the command line, but now with the sox() function, try calling it in R but using the R system() function:

system("sox -V tico.wav /Users/rossahmed/Desktop/out.wav bandreject 4000, 2000)

sox() is essentially a wrapper for system("sox...") etc., so maybe this will help narrow down where the problem is.

You might also try specifying the location of the tico.wav file (e.g. /Users/rossahmed/Desktop/tico.wav).

messages.subject: Re: Using sox() function
parts:
By typing the location of the input file, I'm now getting some output.

If I run this in terminal:

sox -V /Users/rossahmed/Desktop/ID000094_1.wav /Users/rossahmed/Desktop/out.wav bandreject 4000, 3500


Or this in R:

system("sox -V /Users/rossahmed/Desktop/tico.wav /Users/rossahmed/Desktop/out.wav bandreject 4000, 3500")

I get this output both times:

sox:      SoX v
sox INFO formats: detected file format type `wav'
sox INFO wav: EXTENSIBLE
sox FAIL bandreject: usage: frequency width[h|k|q|o]

This suggests to me sox is installed but is failing to remove frequencies between 3500 and 4000. Any ideas why it is failing?

thanks
Ross

messages.author: bd43b7b3f9d02f7d
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Re: Using sox() function
parts:
The comma seems to be the problem. When SoX is expecting several values,
as in this case, just separate them with a space. The command should be:


sox -V /Users/rossahmed/Desktop/ID000094_1.wav
/Users/rossahmed/Desktop/out.wav bandreject 4000 3500



Luis J. Villanueva
http://research.CoquiPR.com
